text:
Anya P: Quick sync — we need a rollout plan for tenant-targeted feature flags + staged regional canaries for the new routing + fallback behavior. Customer asks landed from Atlazo and FinCorp today.
Sam K: TL;DR on asks?
Anya P: They want opt-in beta per-tenant, ability to opt-back quickly, and stronger SLA guarantees during the beta window. Also want telemetry exposed (latency + cost delta). :eyes:
Liz (PM): Confirming: launch criteria are no >1% p50 latency regression and <0.05% error bump across sampled traffic, and documented rollback steps. Customers expect a 2-week pilot.
Ravi: propose phased canary: 0.5% global -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 48h windows. For region-first launches: region 1 (us-west) only for first stage, then add eu-west.
Darren M: +1. Add tenant-sticky flags so we don't flip users mid-session. Also we need a per-tenant kill switch and an account-level fallback to a smaller model variant.
Sam K: For safety, we should also have an automatic circuit-breaker: if p95 latency increases >30% or errors >200% for 1h, auto-failover to baseline model and revert flag for affected tenants.
Eng-PlatformBot: Deploy preview created: deploy/1718064000-preview -> nodes: r-uw1[3], r-eu1[2]. Metrics pipeline attached: /dash/rollouts/1718064000-preview
Anya P: Scope negotiation: do we ship full per-tenant UI for flags? or start with API-only + ops dashboard? Ops wants UI later.
Liz (PM): Start API-only + ops dashboard for pilot. UI can be tied to Q3. Must support per-tenant TTL and manual override.
Ravi: For A/B test portion, send 30% traffic to new routing and 70% to control for signal collection before moving to larger slices. Use bucketing by account ID, deterministic.
Darren M: Note: we need tracing tags for route-version and fallback-reason. That helps postmortems. Add to the telemetry schema.
Sam K: Quick config example for flagging + canary router (proto):
```
flag: tenant_routing_v2
scope: tenant
buckets:
  - stage: canary
    pct: 0.5
    region: us-west
  - stage: ramp
    pct: 10
    regions: [us-west, eu-west]
fallback: model_small
circuit_breaker:
  p95_delta_pct: 30
  error_multiplier: 2.0
```
Ravi: We'll need a small experiment harness to validate user-visible diffs (latency, hallucination rate, token cost). Suggest sampling responses for automatic quality checks.
Anya P: Who owns runbook + rollout doc? I can write initial draft but need SRE input for thresholds and runbook steps.
Darren M: I'll take the runbook for failover steps and postmortem template. Will coordinate with SRE on automated rollback triggers.
Liz (PM): I'll own stakeholder comms and customer pilot invites. Need a clear FAQ for customers describing expected behaviors and rollback promises.
Sam K: Implementation notes: use existing feature-flag infra (ff-service) + router-layer tagging. We should avoid a heavy migration; stick to API + ops dashboard as Liz suggested.
Eng-PlatformBot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window in us-west at 2024-06-15 02:00 UTC. Avoid big ramps overlapping that window.
Ravi: Action items: 1) Anya draft rollout doc + sample flag configs. 2) Darren runbook + SRE thresholds. 3) Sam infra changes + experiment harness. 4) Liz customer comms. I'll own telemetry checks.
Anya P: Timeline proposal: draft by EOD Friday, internal dry-run next Tue, pilot start in 2 weeks. Any objections?
Sam K: Works for infra schedule.
Darren M: fine. Will sync with SRE on Monday.
Liz (PM): Good. I'll prepare customer invite list and FAQ.
Anya P: Cool. I'll open a proper doc in the product workspace and link back here. If anyone has immediate constraints (region capacity, quota) flag now. :thumbsup:
Sam K: one constraint — eu-west quota is tight for dedicated pools; may need temporary burst or region-order swap. Noted.
Anya P: Noted — Sam, can you add estimated extra GPU hours to the doc?
Sam K: Will do.
Ravi: Also adding a small automated check: if uplift in token cost > 25% for selected tenants, signal a warning but don't auto-rollback (ops decision).
Darren M: +1. We want human-in-loop for cost-sensitivity until we have confidence.
Liz (PM): Great. Closing: Anya will post doc link here when done. Everyone please react with :white_check_mark: when you've assigned your tasks.
Anya P: Thanks all — filing the doc now. :sparkles:
